patterns.note: A high-contrast color scheme featuring vibrant, almost neon, lime green (#00df1a) as the primary accent and background color, paired with deep dark greys (#121212) and pure black (#000) for text and backgrounds, and white (#fff) for text on dark backgrounds.
Asymmetrical section layouts often pair large, playful 3D illustrations or product mockups on one side with concise text blocks and calls-to-action on the other, creating dynamic visual interest.
Prominent, oversized, and bold sans-serif headings are used for key messages, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact, contrasting with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.

The header transitions from transparent with white text to a sticky, dark background with smaller elements upon scrolling. Content sections animate into view with subtle fade-up or slide-up effects as they enter the viewport.
The core brand tagline 'It's not a bank, it's Lemon' is repeated in a full-width, hero-like section just before the footer, reinforcing the brand message with a distinct background.

technique_notes: The hero section features a dynamic, fluid background animation, likely a video or complex CSS keyframe animation, creating an organic, moving gradient effect behind the static text and CTA.
The primary navigation bar uses a sticky effect, initially transparent over the hero, then shrinking slightly and gaining a solid dark background as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections throughout the page are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements like text blocks, images, and cards subtly fade in and slide upwards as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and some section backgrounds, giving a soft, friendly feel with a subtle to medium radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with the hero section being quite airy. Content sections use comfortable padding, and card grids have consistent, moderate gutters.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly saturated, almost neon, lime green as a primary brand color, combined with deep dark backgrounds and playful 3D illustrative elements, creates a unique energetic and modern aesthetic. The dynamic, fluid background animation in the hero section further enhances this vibrant feel.
